channel.title: robin.vision – Food for Thought
channel.description: Riding the data flow of value creation

item.title: Rules an agent can keep
item.description: 'Be careful' is not a rule: how SMART helps you write rules an agent can be checked against, and where the system itself needs a lock as well.

item.title: Agents need a budget
item.description: With AI agents, the cost lies not in the question but in the route the agent picks for itself. Five rules for keeping spend and results in view.

item.title: Agent, automation or assistant?
item.description: Not every task needs an AI agent. When choosing software, first ask what it decides on its own – and where it stops.

item.title: The position that can't be filled
item.description: Automate the routine and you abolish the apprenticeship – software only eases the skills shortage if firms rethink how people learn the trade.

item.title: Mistakes multiply – why ARP starts with getting your house in order
item.description: A faulty booking rule or flawed prior-year data repeats itself with every transaction – so before bringing in agents, take a hard look at the old rules.

item.title: The end of ERP as we know it – why internal interfaces are only a stopgap
item.description: AI is reshaping ERP rather than doing away with it – and internal interfaces are only needed for as long as a company's own systems stay apart.

item.title: Seamless data flow – where data still slips between paper and screen
item.description: Every time data has to switch format, mistakes creep in – along with extra steps that the procedural documentation required by the GoBD has to explain.

item.title: E-invoicing: when the data becomes the invoice
item.description: Since the changes to Section 14 of the German VAT Act and the GoBD, the structured data is the invoice – and the picture of it has lost its raison d'être.
